sources.ref: Topping Home web app v1.17.0 (https://home.toppingaudio.com/): the E50 II's session, its 3 configs and the firmware it refuses

meta.notes: As topping-home. Up to 3 stored configs; the app cannot delete one. The app refuses to control firmware below 1.52, and so does the handler; Topping's page asks for 1.56 or later. The EQ has no switch of its own: selecting no config turns it off. The app shows the EQ as unavailable in DSD and above 192 kHz. Config numbers count from 0 here, as the app's device screen sends them; its EQ screen has a mode that counts from 1 on some firmware, which only a device can settle. The product name is a guess: the app tells its devices apart by a product name it strips of spaces and case, so the exact string a device reports is not known until one is read.
